comment.body: Please do not post or email the original personal address. Could you create an invented address-like sample using the same font, size and contrast, and attach that image with the selected OCR language and expected versus extracted text? That would let us distinguish recognition errors from clipboard formatting while preserving the fast single-shortcut workflow. Snipping Tool can be a comparison, not a requirement to abandon Text Extractor.
